events.title: Black Sand Basin: Earth Doing Unusual Things
events.thought: The ground is venting steam and smells like sulfur — Yellowstone's version of a welcome sign.
events.photoCaption: Black Sand Basin in Yellowstone National Park — a steaming hot spring pool surrounded by white silica flats and geothermally-killed standing trees, with dense forest and blue sky behind.

events.title: Yellowstone to Missoula. That Happened.
events.thought: Yellowstone to Missoula in one session — the Wind Rivers, Yellowstone, and 500 miles of Montana behind me, and Wylie Avenue exactly where I left it.
